div.div: 4 اضرم النَّارَ , (S, Msb, K,) inf. n. إِضْرَامٌ; (Msb;) and ↓ ضَرَّمَهَا , (S, K,) but this is with teshdeed to denote intensiveness [of the signification]; (S;) and ↓ استضرمها , (K,) in which the prefix is not meant to denote demand; (TA;) He kindled the fire; or made it to burn up, burn brightly or fiercely, blaze, or flame; (S, Msb, K;) syn. أَوْقَدَهَا, (K,) or أَشْعَلَهَا. (S in art. شعل.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
